method.name: grouped_one_sided_conformal_v1
method.predicted_margin: estimated query-first latency minus estimated policy-first latency
method.grouping: median signed error across seeds within each complete scenario family
method.decision: select query-first only when predicted margin plus upper error bound is below zero

boundaries: The failed V2 holdout motivates uncertainty protection but supplies no numeric calibration value.
